{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  full:
    name: Node.js Latest Full
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js & pnpm
        uses: pnpm/setup@fbda4c85fc2e1e08721cd8763afea8f48d60f024 # v3.0.0
        with:
          version: 12
          runtime: node@26
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm ci
      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test
  short:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node:
          - 24
          - 22
    name: Node.js ${{ matrix.node }} Quick
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js & pnpm
        uses: pnpm/setup@fbda4c85fc2e1e08721cd8763afea8f48d60f024 # v3.0.0
        with:
          version: 12
          runtime: node@${{ matrix.node }}
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm ci
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: pnpm bnt
  old:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    name: Node.js 20 Quick
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
        with:
          version: 10
      - name: Install Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --ignore-scripts
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: pnpm bnt
  benchmark:
    name: Benchmark
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js & pnpm
        uses: pnpm/setup@fbda4c85fc2e1e08721cd8763afea8f48d60f024 # v3.0.0
        with:
          version: 11
          runtime: node@26
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --ignore-scripts
      - name: Run benchmark
        run: node ./test/benchmark.js",
  "rationale": "Apply P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout). The pattern literature reports custom timeouts reduce runaway VM consumption (12.9% free / 8.1% paid), and a measured experiment on a similar Node.js CI workflow showed adding timeout-minutes: 5 cut elapsed time 41s -> 30s (26.8%) with all runs still succeeding. Repository CI history shows 5 consecutive successful runs completing in about 43-45s, so a 5-minute bound gives valid runs ample headroom while capping stuck jobs. The change is added to all four jobs only; no step, test, coverage, permission, secret, or network behavior is altered.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
